description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Gilgamesh], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical) V2], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Buff Fire 40% (15s)], [Dualcast Fire 1] to all allies if Fire Elemental Buff, grants [Dualcast Fire 3], [Fire Ability Instant Cast 3], [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to all allies if not.

description.name: Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Fire attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Fire 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical) V2
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Fire ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Buff Fire 40% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 40%, cumulable

description.name: Fire Ability Instant Cast 3
description.text: Instant cast speed for Fire abilities

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Gilgamesh
description.text: Fire abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Fire abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]
